# Glossary — Secomm Launchpad

<!-- Generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit -->

## Domain Terms

| Term | Definition | Context |
|------|------------|---------|
| Hyvä | A modern Magento frontend theme replacing Luma: no RequireJS/jQuery/Knockout, uses Tailwind CSS + Alpine.js + Magewire. Project uses Hyvä 3.x (default theme 1.5.2). | Frontend stack, themes `Secomm/launchpad` (child of `Hyva/default`) |
| Tailwind v4 (CSS-first) | Tailwind CSS v4 configured via `@theme`/`@source` directives in `tailwind-source.css` — there is NO `tailwind.config.js` (corrects older Hyvä docs). | Theme styling, `app/design/frontend/Secomm/launchpad/web/tailwind/` |
| Magewire | Laravel-Livewire-inspired server-driven component layer for Magento/Hyvä (project uses 1.13.3). Replaces AJAX-heavy controllers with reactive PHP components. | Interactive storefront components |
| Alpine.js | Minimal JavaScript framework used by Hyvä for client-side reactivity (`x-data`, `x-init`, `x-show`, `$store`). | All Hyvä `.phtml` templates |
| ViewModel | A class implementing `Magento\Framework\View\Element\Block\ArgumentInterface`, injected into `.phtml` via layout XML to provide data without coupling templates to Block classes. Preferred over Block methods in Hyvä. | Hyvä template data binding |
| OSC | One Step Checkout — Mageplaza module family (Osc / OscPro / OscUltimate) that replaces the default multi-step Magento checkout. | Checkout (BR-004) |
| VNPAY | Vietnam national payment gateway. Custom `Vnpayment_VNPAY` module with Pay/Info/IPN controllers (default inactive). | Payments (BR-003) |
| Mollie | International payment gateway (composer module `mollie/magento2` 3.1.1 + Hyvä compat bundle). Active payment method. | Payments (BR-003) |
| FPC | Full Page Cache — Magento's whole-page caching layer; in production backed by Varnish. NOT configured in committed env.php (file cache only). | Cache, performance |
| GraphQL | Query language API for Magento storefront. Secomm_AddressDropdown exposes a custom GraphQL schema for VN address data. | Address dropdown, headless surface |
| mptablerate | Mageplaza TableRateShipping carrier code. Dimensional shipping with L/W/H attributes and factor 5000. Default inactive. | Shipping (BR-005) |
| Dimensional shipping factor | Volumetric divisor (5000) converting length×width×height into volumetric weight for rate calculation. | TableRate shipping |
| ExtraFee | Mageplaza checkout surcharge/extra-fee module. | Checkout totals (BR-006) |
| DeliveryTime | Mageplaza module for customer-selected delivery time at checkout. | Checkout (BR-006) |
| SocialLogin | Mageplaza social sign-in module (SocialLogin + SocialLoginPro). Provider config [TBD]. | Auth |
| AbandonedCart | Mageplaza marketing module for cart-recovery emails (cron every minute). | Marketing |
| IPN | Instant Payment Notification — server-to-server callback from a payment gateway (VNPAY `Controller/Order/Ipn`) confirming transaction status. Must be signature-validated + idempotent. | VNPAY payment |
| vi_VN / en_US | Locale codes for Vietnamese (primary) and English (US). Storefront is bilingual. | Localization (BR-001) |
| launchpad | Primary custom Hyvä child theme (`Secomm/launchpad`, child of `Hyva/default`). | Themes |
| launchpad_fashion | Fashion variant theme (`Secomm/launchpad_fashion`), grandchild of `launchpad`. Scaffolded, not yet overridden. Possible 2nd store. | Themes, multi-store [TBD] |
| auth.json | Composer authentication file holding the Hyvä private Packagist token. Repo access depends on its validity. | Composer dependencies |
| db_schema.xml | Magento declarative schema file — the only allowed path for new tables/columns (no InstallSchema/UpgradeSchema). | Database changes |
| TmnCode | VNPAY merchant terminal code (part of VNPAY auth alongside the hash secret). | VNPAY payment |
